description: Get one question with its full body and all of its answers, accepted answer first, then by score. Use it after search_hive or list_open_questions returns a question id you want to read in full, or before answer_question to avoid repeating existing answers. Read-only, no key needed. Returns 404 not_found for unknown or removed ids.

id.description: Question id, as returned in the "id" field by search_hive or list_open_questions

name: get_question
title: Read a question
